name: alpha-vantage
description: Reads Alpha Vantage daily, weekly, monthly, and intraday OHLCV time series plus the latest global quote for a configured stock symbol. In architecture v2 this quarantine bundle dispatches live reads through a Tier-2 hook that delegates to the legacy connector until the wave 6 cutover.

risk.read: external Alpha Vantage API reads performed by the legacy connector via a Tier-2 hook
